name: agent-dashboard
description: One Dashboard pane showing usage limits and context bars, the task list, test runs, running sessions and subagents (/dashboard brings it to the front)

planNote.title: Plan multi-step requests
planNote.description: Tell Claude to write long or multi-part requests into its task list first

queueMessages.title: Queue mid-turn messages
queueMessages.description: A message sent while Claude is working is added to the end of its task list instead of derailing it (start it with !now to act on it right away)

buildReminder.title: Background build reminder
buildReminder.description: Remind Claude to run long builds and tests in the background when it ran one in the foreground
